<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="RhV1Ljt5VV1ByqQdVfeP"> <mxGraphModel dx="3738" dy="1081" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": " flowchart TB
 START[\"Run the benchmark\"] --> CFG[\"1. Write the algorithm<br/>into the nginx config\"]
 CFG --> TEST[\"2. Check the config with nginx -t<br/><i>bad config = skip, never measure</i>\"] 
 TEST --> LOAD[\"3. Reload nginx, then<br/>drive real load\"]
 LOAD --> READ[\"4. Read X-Backend-Id<br/>on every response\"]

 READ --> JSON[\"results/l1-benchmark.json<br/><b>raw data</b>\"]
 READ --> MD[\"results/l1-benchmark.md<br/><b>table from the same data</b>\"]

 JSON --> YOURS[\"results/chosen-config.md<br/><b>your written decision</b>\"]
 MD --> YOURS

 PROBE[\"probe.js --all / --nat\"] --> ASSERT[\"<b>Assert the result.</b><br/>Exit non-zero if it 
 does not hold.\"]

 NOTE[\"<b>Two rules that keep this honest:</b><br/>1. The table is generated AFTER the
 data,<br/> so they can never disagree.<br/>2. A probe ASSERTS — it doesn't just print.<br/> If 
 L7's /admin/ ever hit two backends,<br/> the script fails loudly.\"]

 JSON --> NOTE
 ASSERT --> NOTE

 style TEST fill:#e8eef7,stroke:#4a6fa5
 style JSON fill:#c8e6c8,stroke:#3f8f5a,stroke-width:2px
 style MD fill:#c8e6c8,stroke:#3f8f5a,stroke-width:2px
 style ASSERT fill:#fdd0d0,stroke:#b04a4a,stroke-width:2px
 style YOURS fill:#fdf3e3,stroke:#b8860b,stroke-width:2px
 style NOTE fill:#f5f5f5,stroke:#888",
 "config": null

div.div:
Two rules that keep this honest:
1. The table is generated AFTER the
data,
so they can never disagree.
2. A probe ASSERTS — it doesn't just print.
If
L7's /admin/ ever hit two backends,
the script fails loudly.
